final_prompt:
Use case: infographic-story
Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article
Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes the article. Theme: replacing two loose date fields with five typed interval shapes that behave the same way in memory and in PostgreSQL. The reader should quickly feel how interval modeling removes boundary ambiguity.

Summary angle: from the confusion of two date cards, collapse the messy edges into five readable interval shapes, then connect the same interval logic to an in-memory track and a SQL track.
Narrative flow: 3-beat process. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and three supporting narrative beats. Each beat must map to the article's information blocks rather than generic decoration.
Information blocks:
- Problem: two slightly offset date cards with an unstable gap between them, visible label 两个日期, numeric chip 2.
- Mechanism: exactly five interval shapes total, four colored interval blocks plus one empty dashed slot, arranged in an isometric conceptual systems scene, visible label 五种形状, numeric chip 5.
- Evidence: two parallel interval rails align in the center and connect by a narrow bridge, visible label 同一语义.

Main metaphor: scattered date cards assembled into a set of modular interval blocks.
Subject: exactly five interval shapes, four colored blocks and one empty slot, with two blocks touching at a boundary, being assembled from two date cards.
Composition/framing: isometric space, left-to-right progression, one strong central focal subject, generous negative space for a wide cover.
Style/medium: combine isometric conceptual systems scene with the selected visual style descriptor: soft shojo-inspired manga look, elegant linework, expressive faces, gentle decorative details, luminous pastel accents. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist.
Color palette: teal, warm coral, cream, ink charcoal; restrained pastel highlights.
Visible text policy: allow only 1-3 short Chinese labels or number chips, sourced from the information blocks: 两个日期, 五种形状, 同一语义, plus optional numeric chips 2 and 5. Each label <= 6 Chinese characters. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names.
Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter.
Avoid: poster title, long text, fake UI, dashboard, fake chart axes, watermark, code rain, robot, neon skyline, decorative clutter.
